acceptance.any_failure: No production activation; preserve attempt and stop. No new policy, subset or hyperparameter search in this protocol.
proof_gates: faithful actual caller and old vector parity
complete coherent output matrices and target-independent support
disjoint assessment model and full-history fixture model lineage remain separate

assessment_vs_deployment.activation: Only after all acceptance and canonical API/CLI/default-policy parity tests pass; prior user integration authorization persists, but this protocol makes no activation.
assessment_vs_deployment.assessment_parameters: Retain prefix-fit/calibration lineage for historical held-out metrics; do not score full-history fitted rows as held-out.
assessment_vs_deployment.future_fixture_parameters: Full admitted history as of actual future cutoff, calibration off, separate from the assessment model.
assessment_vs_deployment.global_scope: Default Dixon policy only; do not claim benefit for untested GBDT/hybrid or other explicit settings.
assessment_vs_deployment.metrics_lineage: Every diagnostic explicitly identifies evaluation model/fit and held-out IDs; every fixture identifies the full-history forecast model/fit.
assessment_vs_deployment.reference_preservation: Preserve an immutable source snapshot before modifying canonical caller/model code so old reference evidence remains replayable.

caller_parity.mismatch_policy: Abort before new score attachment/evaluation. Do not substitute archived vectors for a mismatched actual caller or choose the favorable reconstruction.
caller_parity.scope: Use the same canonical local data/fixture/history selection semantics with the frozen block input snapshot. Record any harness IO adapter explicitly.
caller_parity.unused_gbdt: May suppress only after synthetic differential proof that all selected Dixon fixture outputs remain unchanged; no change to DC fitting, partitions, calibration or reconciliation.

execution.independent_verification: No refits: rebuild memberships, restore raw parameters/calibrator state, replay each complete output and all fixed metrics/gates.
required_tests: future/current label poisoning leaves prior state and support unchanged
observed-target support does not affect earlier matrix
zero/out-of-support score fails without clipping or row removal
execution.reuse_branch_choice: Decide and record solely from serialization/caller feasibility before attaching any new scoreline targets, never from model scores.
stages: 36 reference kernel/calibrator reconstructions and caller parity
reuse36 saved full-history states or exactly36 fixed fits if parity requires
attach external labels and compute fixed paired metrics/gates

fixed_dc_kernel.fit_status: Preserve and verify canonical fit status and diagnostics. Any unplanned solver failure aborts; do not score a replacement.
fixed_dc_kernel.solver_initialization_constraints_and_fa: Inherit the exact bound canonical source; no new initialization, alternate solver, decay, penalty, rate clipping or chosen fallback.

inputs.cached_csv_byte_counts: Verify each raw file against its feature input_hashes entry and filename/sha256/bytes in the two pinned acquisition manifests.
inputs.closure_rule: Check current bytes against the old passed verification, source map, feature hashes, CSV hashes and original acquisition manifests; freeze the new reviewed implementation before any new fit.

joint_score.common_scoring_function: For nonnegative integer (h,a), return matrix[h][a] when inside support, else zero. Both policies use this identical rule on their distinct saved matrices.
joint_score.estimand: Negative natural log of probability in each policy actual emitted finite joint score matrix.
joint_score.out_of_support_or_zero_mass: Infinite NLL; preserve row, record cause, fail advancement, and do not compute a misleading finite bootstrap.
joint_score.support_selection: Only frozen goal rates/rho and selected HDA may determine support or existing reconciliation refinement; never observed target goals.
joint_score.undefined_loss_json: Use explicit nonfinite_loss status with null numeric fields and gates false; strict standard JSON only.

metrics.brier: Mean sum of three squared probability errors
metrics.joint_score: Mean observed-score NLL from preclosed emitted matrices over identical2280 fixtures
metrics.one_x_two: Mean natural-log class NLL over all2280 fixtures
metrics.weighting: One equal weight per fixture; identical population for every metric.

dc_frozen_prefix_auto.calibration_membership: The exact saved calibration partition; inherited automatic calibration policy unchanged.
dc_frozen_prefix_auto.raw_model: Actual canonical fit_dixon_coles prefix fit; reconstruct the missing 36 goal-model states.

dc_full_admitted_equal_off.calibration: Identity; no calibration fit and no reuse of a calibrator trained on a different raw model.
dc_full_admitted_equal_off.fit_membership: Every row in the exact full admitted block history, once; not every cached match.
dc_full_admitted_equal_off.reuse: Reuse only after exact source, fit population, serialized goal-parameter and canonical caller/model parity checks. Otherwise fit all 36 blocks once with the same settings.
dc_full_admitted_equal_off.saved_parameters: fits[j].base.dixon_coles.dc_equal in each pinned feature artifact

block_inventory_binding.derivation: Per block preserve source league, source feature path/index, base fit_id/cutoff/fit_match_ids count/fit_ids_sha256/fit_content_sha256; digest complete base.dixon_coles.dc_equal, complete production_default.populations, and ordered matching row IDs; record saved population sample sizes. Sort by (fit_cutoff_utc,league,fit_id), then SHA256 of sorted-key compact JSON.
block_inventory_binding.source: Each pinned feature_artifact: fits[j].base plus the forecast rows with the same fit_id; production_default.populations binds the prefix partitions.

population.missing_or_unreconstructable_row: Fail the attempt; do not drop or silently replace the fixture.
population.resumed_fixture: I1:2024:Fiorentina:Inter retained under its inherited canonical completion-day identity.

purpose: Verify one deliverable operational default-policy improvement, not select a novel best research forecaster.

per_block: actual prefix and candidate attack/defense maps, intercepts and rho
calibrator method plus full fitted isotonic knots or Platt coefficients/intercepts/classes and constructor settings, or identity state
readable independent-replay state plus any exact opaque state required for native replay
per_fixture: raw HDA, selected HDA and final reconciled HDA
base omitted mass and final tail bound

suggested_commit: research(football): specify full-history DC deployment proof

timing.archive_limit: Existing files physically contain exposed labels; target-free assembly means explicit semantic non-use, not absence of label bytes.
timing.external_labels: Attach scoring goals/outcomes only after all 36 blocks and all 2280 complete output states close and hash. Earlier resolved outcomes may train later blocks.
timing.fit_cadence: The same frozen two-month buckets and first-fixture cutoffs; no extra fit when a later result becomes available within the block.
timing.forecast_cutoffs: Original per-fixture forecast_cutoff_utc and block fit_cutoff_utc unchanged; legacy naive timestamps mean UTC.
timing.history_window: The exact saved full block fit_match_ids, independently reconstructed using original local-day window [D-1095,D) and result_available_at <= fit_cutoff_utc.
timing.metadata_first: Establish IDs, dates, source hashes and admitted membership before interpreting numeric training payloads. Future/current fixture values cannot alter earlier parameters, support or outputs.

uncertainty.method: Inherited paired fixed-calendar blocks anchored at each stratum first fixture; omit empty blocks; resample existing blocks with replacement within stratum, preserving original fixture-count stratum weights.
uncertainty.pairing: Same saved row deltas and same sampled block identities for 1X2 and joint-score comparisons.
